answer: Proposed dispute escrow: each paid grader locks a separate reserve larger than 40 epochs of capped seat pay. A quill-signed verdict enters a public challenge window; a randomly drawn independent panel tests an echo of the original evidence, and a proven false verdict burns that reserve. The ledge is one exclusive coin lock per seat, checked by validators. A farm can share a model and borrow coins, but each new grader immobilizes another reserve for 40 epochs; lenders price that term and loss risk. No lock means no seat. This is not a MinePoA rule.
